serial_port.ask: Serial port of the EIA-485/232 adapter wired to the controller (COM4, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
serial_port.help: The controller's comms terminals (HD/HE/HF on a 2416) go to a USB-to-EIA-485 adapter; the adapter appears as a COM port. For a Modbus TCP gateway leave this out and put `host` in config.json instead.

baud.ask: Baud rate set in the controller's comms list (9600 from the factory, 19200 on many furnaces)

unit.ask: Modbus address (Addr in the controller's comms list)
unit.help: 1 unless several controllers share one EIA-485 bus.
